name: io.github.nileshpatil6/telegram-slack-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your personal Telegram and Slack accounts: real DMs, groups and channels via MTProto, plus multi-workspace Slack, with reading enabled by default and sending gated behind an explicit opt-in.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow sending Telegram messages as you. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_USER_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: One Slack user token (xoxp-) per workspace, comma separated (Slack server only)

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow posting to Slack as you. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: CHAT_MCP_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the Telegram session is stored. Defaults to ~/.chat-mcp
